claims.statement: MNKE IMR26650 is specified as an orange, flat-top, unprotected cell with nominal 26 mm x 65 mm dimensions; an independent test covers an exact orange 3500mAh sample.
Steam Engine preserves MNKE IMR 26650 3500mAh 20A as a 3500mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.

The MNKE IMR 26650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry MNKE IMR 26650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2016-01-01 or earlier.
